entities.summary: Baatarsuren Togtokhbayar, known by her pen name Shuudertsetseg (Шүүдэрцэцэг) is a Mongolian journalist, author, filmmaker, and humanitarian. She has received numerous Mongolian literary awards including "Featured Book" awards in 2007 for her novel Шүрэн бугуйвч and in 2008 for her CD Шүүдэрцэцэг. Her 2010 novel Домогт Ану хатан was named National Book of the Year for Mongolian Literature. In 2012 she wrote the screenplay for, produced, and directed the film version of Домогт Ану хатан, released internationally as "Warrior Princess".
